title: Verify a webhook signature
summary: A request whose X-Signalwire-Signature header does not match hex(HMAC-SHA1(signing_key, url + raw_body)) is refused with 403 before any route runs. A matching one, or a matching X-Signalwire-SHA256-Signature, is served.
scenario: A public webhook that must never run a document for a request SignalWire did not send

evidence: https://signalwire.com/docs/swml/guides/webhook-security (fetched 2026-09-02): X-Signalwire-Signature HMAC-SHA1 hex on every signed request, X-Signalwire-SHA256-Signature on call requests; signed payload is url + raw body with no separator; key in Dashboard API Credentials
sdk 3.0.1 implements no verification (no hmac import); standard library here
